text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
W-Who was it?!
Who left a banana peel in a place like this?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it, Windy-chan,
did you happen to set up a prank around here...?"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah!!
This is the biggest blunder of Windy-chan's entire liiife~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Shinko Windy ended up falling into her own prank, thoroughly disheartened.
